progression.narrative: The performance opens on G3 and dwells most on G in Muyeye Bakhtiyari. The line peaks at Eb4 (293.6 Hz) at 0:11.5. It closes on C4, not the tonic (D4 → F3 → Eb3 → G3 → C4 → C4).
